title: Logix iCE40 FPGAs
description: The iCE40 FPGAs of Logix Catalog (www.openlogix.org/catalog/): its file, fpgas/ice40.json, which maps each FPGA ID to its facts. The file's name gives the FPGAs' architecture.

propertyNames.description: "$schema", or an FPGA ID: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, such as ice40hx8k-ct256.

Fpga.description: One iCE40 FPGA: its part, its size and the names the toolchain uses for it.

part_number.description: The vendor's part number, such as ICE40HX4K-TQ144.

nextpnr_device.description: The device nextpnr-ice40 uses (--hx8k, --up5k and so on, without the dashes), such as hx8k.

nextpnr_package.description: The package nextpnr-ice40 uses (--package), such as tq144 or tq144:4k.
